name: Everlane Online
summary:
Everlane Online is a massively multiplayer online role-playing game set in a colorful fantasy world drawn in a chibi art style. Players create a Swordsman, Mage or Archer and explore floating islands, forests, mines and ruins around the town of Everville, taking on quests and monsters alongside other players.

The game's central feature is its specialist cards, which transform a character's appearance, fighting style and skills. Cards of the first generation are earned in solo trials at elemental stones, while stronger cards drop from raids against giant bosses. Characters are joined by pets, partners and mounts, and players can form parties and families, trade at a bazaar, compete in a three-versus-three arena and fight for a crown in a faction war.
